Stage only the seven declared new producer artifacts and this one declared snapshot receipt. The existing selected proposal is already committed: verify its exact hash and source commit without changing it or adding unrelated paths to the archive.

Verify the actual parent commit, exact changed-path set, reachable commit, record IDs and path hashes. Keep commit fields null until observed. Push and make the archive reviewable through the current PR.

Archive the actual approve/revise/inconclusive protocol decision, not an assumed approval. Readiness approval becomes effective only with verified publication of the complete frozen contract. No scientific execution or hypothesis truth/status transition follows from a design archive.

Source audit and design report must distinguish protocol completeness from runner/implementation/LOCKED-plan gates. Missing exact definitions are preserved as technical impediments; no cosmetic success or fabricated result.
completion_gate: Producer terminal receipt and stopped writes bind actual claim identity, exact seven paths, zero science and honest readiness.
Post-commit archive receipt verifies exact paths/hashes, reachable commit/parent and named records; publication/PR readback succeeds before downstream admission.
Parent reranks the complete concrete implementation/readiness next action under standing approval; scientific run and independent review gates remain intact.
handoff.return_format: Exact Coordinator snapshot receipt with observed commit/parent/path hashes and publication metadata; no invented completed state.
